messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert: multiple kv-paged allocator OOMs in us-west-2 cluster (p-07, p-09). Autoscaling triggered container restarts; 3 nodes reported CUDA OOMs in last 20m.

lee (oncall): seeing the same. Paged attention allocator showing slow resident growth, fragmentation pattern. Logs show repeated 'cudaMalloc failed: out of memory' then container restart loops.

maria: any customer impact yet?

lee (oncall): small set of Dedicated customers (tenant ids 84, 129) seeing 5xx spikes and token latency > 2s. Dashboard: error rate up ~6% for those routes.

devendra: can we triage to config change first (evict earlier) and then drain nodes?

lee (oncall): yes. Plan: 1) bump kv cache evict threshold to be more aggressive on affected pool 2) route traffic off p-07/p-09 3) trigger on-demand compaction 4) reprovision nodes if instability persists.

infra-bot: added tags: incident=kv-paged-oom, region=us-west-2, runbook=kv-paged-oom-2025.

maria: commands below to nudge eviction/compaction. Using ops-api to avoid full deploy: 
```bash
# aggressive eviction for pool 'paged-usw2'
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://ops-api.internal/v1/kv/policy -d '{"pool":"paged-usw2","evict_threshold":0.55,"min_free_ratio":0.12}'
# trigger async compaction job
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/v1/kv/compaction?pool=paged-usw2
```

lee (oncall): applying now. Pushing to canary subset first.

lee (oncall): canary looks good for 10m, memory slope flattened on canary nodes.

devendra: start routing 60% of traffic away from p-07/p-09 via routing policy. I can run the routing change.

devendra: routing change done. Customer 84 latency dropped back to baseline, 129 still noisy but improving.

ops@custops: FYI — we've notified affected customers that we're mitigating and will follow up with timeline.

lee (oncall): starting node drain of p-07 to reprovision with fresh driver and updated allocator flags. Draining now.

infra-bot: kubectl cordon p-07; draining pods.

lee (oncall): drain finished, node reprovision kickoff. Replaced NV driver and bumped allocator defrag interval.

maria: defrag config we rolled: 
```json
{"defrag_interval_secs":300, "defrag_target_fragmentation":0.18}
```

lee (oncall): after reprovision, node stayed stable for 20m, no OOMs. Error rate for impacted routes down to 0.4%.

devendra: leaving the eviction threshold at 0.55 for 6 hours, then dial back to 0.65 if steady. Also scheduling a follow-up perf job to run allocation histograms across workload to catch fragmentation hotspots.

ops@custops: customers confirmed service restored; they requested a short RCA.

lee (oncall): creating incident ticket and assigning to eng-runtime + infra for postmortem. Preliminary cause: progressive KV-page fragmentation + suboptimal defrag cadence + a CVE driver/regression that made allocations less compact.

infra-bot: incident ticket created: INC-2025-174600 (linked). Assigning to @maria @devendra for root cause analysis.

maria: added action items: (1) telemetry alert for fragmentation slope (2) automated compaction run if fragmentation > 0.2 for 10m (3) test node reprovision playbook in staging.

lee (oncall): handing off to next oncall — summary pinned in incident ticket. If anything regresses reopen thread. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: handoff recorded: from lee (oncall) to sam (oncall) at 1746003167. Handoff note: mitigations applied, nodes reprovisioned, customers notified, postmortem scheduled.
